# Food, goods & trade
[textlink="Mining & Industry" link="CMUGuideIndustry"] · [textlink="Crafting recipes" link="CMUGuideIndustryRecipes"]
## Cook a meal
Put ingredients into the appropriate pot, pan or pie plate; add the required liquid. Place the vessel in the stove's cooking slot. Open the door to add fuel; ignite a fueled wood stove. For the electric oven, insert cookware while open, then [bold]close the door[/bold] and supply power.
Examine cookware for progress. Use a bowl or plate on prepared food to serve it. [textlink="Kitchen basics" link="CMUGuideCooking"]
## Sell locally
The stall owner needs a [bold]trade licence[/bold]. Use an item on the stall to stock it, then open its window to set the price. Buyers open the stall and choose what to buy. Citizen consoles also offer player trade and auctions.
## Ship an order
An authorized requisitions/colony-command user opens the anchored logistics console, chooses a landing zone and world-map city, then calls the trade shuttle. Order goods in the console; physically load exports and unload deliveries. Check the destination and cargo before sending the shuttle away.
## Skip the slow start Cargo can supply hand saws, a concrete mixer and an [bold]industry starter crate[/bold]. Open the sealed industry crate with a crowbar. Job starter crates may supply logistics, administration or production equipment. Check current cargo listings for availability and prices.
[bold]Try one small order:[/bold] equip a miner, feed a crew or deliver building supplies. Use the [textlink="machine reference" link="CMUGuideIndustryMachines"] for sewing, tanning, canning and other finished goods.
